repo_notes.content: WKApp - A modern HTML5 UI framework for building iOS apps with Pythonista 3 and WebKit

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to pythonista-wkapp: what it is, why it exists, key concepts, and how the major components fit together. Links to child pages for details.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for installing and running a minimal WKApp application in Pythonista 3. Covers StaSh/pip installation, the three-line bootstrap, directory structure requirements, and first run.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explains the hybrid Python/WebKit architecture: how the Bottle.py WSGI server, Mako templating, WKWebView, and the Python–JavaScript bridge all interact at a high level. Introduces the main classes and their roles.

pages.title: Core Framework (wkapp module)
pages.purpose: Overview of the wkapp Python package — its public API, package structure, and how its sub-components collaborate. Links to child pages for each major sub-system.

pages.title: WKApp Application Class
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the WKApp class: initialization, run(), exit(), server route setup, the webview delegate callbacks, and the wkapp:// custom URL scheme handler.

pages.title: WKAppServer and Request Lifecycle
pages.purpose: Covers the WKAppServer threading model, Bottle route registration (static, template GET/POST, root), WKAppPlugin middleware, CORS/security headers, and graceful shutdown.

pages.title: View System: WKViews, WKView, and View Lifecycle
pages.purpose: Explains the WKViews registry, WKView mixin, view_class pattern, lifecycle events (on_init, on_prepare, on_loading, on_loaded, on_get, on_post), and form/query-string auto-binding.

pages.title: Python–JavaScript Bridge
pages.purpose: Details the two-way interop mechanism: view.invoke() in JavaScript, webview_on_invoke() in Python, WKJavascript serialization helpers, WKElementsRef DOM abstraction, and eval_js/eval_js_async from Python.

pages.title: Mako Templating Integration
pages.purpose: Covers WKAppTemplate, WKViewsLexer (custom ${}/%{} escaping), TemplateLookup configuration, view-class mixin injection, and template inheritance chain.

pages.title: WKWebView iOS Bridge
pages.purpose: Overview of the bundled wkwebview.py module — the Python wrapper around iOS WKWebView. Links to child pages for threading, URL schemes, and the JavaScript bridge.

pages.title: WKWebView Class and Core API
pages.purpose: Documents the WKWebView class: initialization, load_url/load_html, eval_js/eval_js_async, add_script/add_style, delegate property, script message handlers, and the console REPL.

pages.title: Concurrency and Threading Model
pages.purpose: Explains the three-thread model (main thread, _webviewDispatcher, URL scheme worker threads), how script messages are queued to avoid deadlocks, and the synchronous eval_js queue mechanism.

pages.title: Custom URL Scheme Handler
pages.purpose: Covers the WKURLSchemeHandler integration: scheme_* method registration, _urlSchemeTaskPool, _urlSchemeTaskWorker lifecycle, NSHTTPURLResponse synthesis, and the wkapp:// scheme used by WKApp.

pages.title: Template System and Views Directory
pages.purpose: Overview of the views/ directory structure, template inheritance chain, and the bundled base templates. Links to child pages for base templates and frontend assets.

pages.title: Base Template Hierarchy
pages.purpose: Documents the template inheritance chain: base/app.html (root HTML shell) → base/layout.html → base/view.html → view.html → user views. Explains each template's role and override points.

pages.title: Frontend Static Assets
pages.purpose: Covers the static/ directory: bundled Bootstrap 5, jQuery, wkapp.js (WKApp/WKView JS classes), and wkapp.css. Explains how app.js and app.css in views/ are used for per-app customization.

pages.title: Default index.html Placeholder
pages.purpose: Explains the built-in views/index.html placeholder page: IndexPlaceHolderView, the self-documenting codeblock helper, and how it is replaced by a user-created views/index.html.

pages.title: Test Views and Examples
pages.purpose: Overview of the test/ directory: the suite of example views demonstrating framework features. Links to child pages for standard view tests and advanced WASM experiments.

pages.title: Standard Test Views
pages.purpose: Documents test/views/index.html (navigation hub), first_view.html (view.invoke demo), and test_view.html (form binding with on_get/on_post lifecycle hooks). Shows patterns for testing view features.

pages.title: WebAssembly and Pyodide Integration Tests
pages.purpose: Covers the experimental WASM views: web_asm.html (Pyodide + Wasmer SDK), pyodide.html (Pyodide Web Worker pattern), and preact.html. Explains Cross-Origin Isolation requirements and the coi-serviceworker.js workaround.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of all codebase-specific terms, abbreviations, class names, and domain concepts that an onboarding engineer needs to know, with code pointers.
